subject: Re: Project Sirocco kickoff: CFQ as a first-class eval product
body:
Wrapping up the Sirocco milestone thread.

Decisions: leaderboard went live internally April 20 with Hyun's reproduced-by-us badge scheme — already 3 submissions from the language portfolio. The hosted dataset serves from Corpus and the harness runs the full MCD-MEAN protocol (average over the three MCD splits with 95% CIs) with one command.

Scope cut: SPARQL-level error analysis tooling moves to a fast-follow. It kept growing and I'd rather hit the window than gold-plate.

Nadia — we'd like a Launch Review Board slot the week of May 11 for sign-off on opening the leaderboard to all portfolios; no external demo yet.

Small typo in the announce draft btw, it's "Compositional Freebase Questions" not "Queries" — fixed.

Dmitri
